{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders to compute only completed order revenue
completed_sales = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute total revenue from completed orders by channel
revenue_by_channel_completed = completed_sales.groupby('channel')['revenue'].sum()

print('Total revenue from completed orders by channel:\n', revenue_by_channel_completed)"}
